headline: Apollo 12 lands next to a robot
post_facts: Landed in the Ocean of Storms

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in nineteen sixty-nine... Americans landed on the Moon. Again.

scenes.label: Ocean of Storms, the Moon
scenes.caption: Alan Bean on the lunar surface
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] Pete Conrad and Alan Bean set down in the Ocean of Storms.

scenes.label: lightning strikes during launch
scenes.text: [calmly] Days earlier, lightning had struck their rocket twice.

scenes.label: Surveyor 3
scenes.caption: Conrad at the robot probe
scenes.text: [softly] They landed within walking distance of Surveyor three, a robot probe from nineteen sixty-seven.
